name: JavOrganizer
overview: JAV metadata and cover art from 19 websites, scraped in parallel
description: Identifies JAV titles by product code in the file name and scrapes up to 19 websites simultaneously per code — JavLibrary, JavDB, JavBus, MissAV (+mirror), OneJAV, FANZA/DMM digital + DVD, JavLand, 123AV, SEXTB, SupJav, JavGG, JavSeen, JavMix, JavQuick, JavTube, jav.guru and MGStage — merging English titles, actresses and male actors, studio, genres, release date, runtime, cover art and scene backdrops. Advanced anti-ban system, Cloudflare bypass via optional FlareSolverr, automatic scanning, manual Scan page with live progress, gender browse collections ordered by total views, and gender-aware people collections.

The normal scan no longer re-fetches metadata that has already been scraped. An item whose cached scrape is still within its cache TTL is now skipped outright. Before this, an item that came back sparse - a site answered with a title and a cast but no genres, studio or overview, which is what the item kept showing - was re-queued on every scan, because it already had a provider id and therefore matched no other heal condition. On a library where the sites simply have no genres for a code, that meant re-scraping already-fetched metadata on every pass, forever. Queued now: never-scraped items, title-only items, sparse items only once their cached scrape has aged out, and Japanese-titled items when the plugin language is English, bounded by the provider's retry counter. Left alone: everything whose cached scrape is still valid. The deep pass remains the explicit escape hatch that ignores all of this. Verified on a live Jellyfin 12.0.0 server mid-way through a large heal pass: the scan skips completed work and only touches what is genuinely unscraped.

Adds jav.guru to the scraper catalog. The scan progress indicator now reports live progress with elapsed time and an estimate of the remaining work, and names the item being scraped. The plugin controller requires an authenticated session, so anonymous requests can no longer start or cancel scans. Fixes a zero-padding mismatch between ADN-29 and ADN-029 style codes, tightens ban-page detection so jav.guru's comment widget no longer trips it, and bounds the language retry counter.

Actor and actress collections are rebuilt as nested BoxSets so each performer's videos sit inside their own card under the gender card. Performer portraits are collected from every image source on the cast pages rather than only the img title attribute, so performer cards and collection posters show a real face. Collections no longer re-download a poster that is already present.
